QUICK MEMORY REVISION
Recall the essential ideas

Payment request and redirect flow
Create → redirect → verify → fulfill.

Sandbox vs production
Test money ≠ real money.

Transaction reference
Order identifies purchase; transaction identifies
payment.

Payment status lifecycle
State machine, not a Boolean.

Server-side transaction verification
Trust provider, match stored facts.

Callback vs webhook
Return shows; webhook informs.

Signature verification
Verify before parse/trust (per contract).

Idempotency and duplicate payment
prevention
One intent, one effect.

Failed and cancelled payments
Failed ≠ unknown.

Amount and currency verification
Amount + currency + merchant.

Secure handling of payment data
Minimize data, maximize trust.

Logging without exposing secrets
Trace IDs, not secrets.

PCI DSS awareness
Scope first, controls next.

Explain actual LGPS implementation
Problem → contribution → verification → result.

Refunds and chargebacks
Refund is a return; chargeback is a dispute.

Payment timeout and unknown status
No response ≠ no charge.

Webhook replay protection
Authentic does not mean new.

Money types
Money is exact, not approximate.
